def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) where
  toFun := fun x => fun (a : { a // ¬p a }) => x.1 a
  invFun := fun y => ⟨fun a => match Decidable.decision (p a) with
    | .isTrue h => x₀ ⟨a, h⟩
    | .isFalse h => y ⟨a, h⟩,
    by { intro s; simp [Function.comp, Subtype.val]; congr; simp [s.2] } ⟩
  left_inv := by { intro x; ext a; cases Decidable.decision (p a); simp [toFun, invFun, x.2] }
  right_inv := by { intro y; ext a; cases Decidable.decision (p a); simp [toFun, invFun] }
